title: ⌘K command palette: "Open Full Search Page" cannot be found by the words of its own label ("open", "full search")
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33058 · search.command-palette-navigation · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (stock showcase @ ee9ad834, admin)
1. Open the console, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K.
2. Type `open` → no items. Type `full search` → no items.
3. Type `search` or `full` → the Actions row "Open Full Search Page" appears.

Expected: the row is found by the words its label shows.

Mechanism: `showFullSearch` tests the query against `FULL_SEARCH_VALUE = 'search all results full page'` (ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx:799), not the visible label, and that string has neither "open" nor the contiguous "full search". Low severity.
